This podcast has been translated into Spanish using artificial intelligence.

Warning: there may be errors or inconsistencies in both the translation and the diction.

The transcript was translated from English to Spanish using Anthropic's "Opus 5" model. The Spanish audio was generated with an open-source TTS model fine-tuned on Naval's and Nivi's voices.
